description: Tier-3 reference game (D-056, CONTENT §12) on the generated dev archipelago of seed 1053001 from the content starting stock only: bootstrap_citizens step for step (all but its final wait, to minute 132), then the same attentive play (plan order, whole-minute waits, nearest sites a road reaches, no pauses, demolitions or stock grants): route 1 drops its stone leg (planks out, tools home), the tavern and a Trading Post upgrade, and every full Settler house that passes the gate upgraded to Citizens (22 at home, keeping 18 Settler houses); on island 2 (iron, clay, hops) a market, six Settler houses and a quarry, the idle start sloop on a second route (wool garments out, bricks and stone home) and three Citizen houses to staff the clay pit and brickworks; at home one alternative per Citizen category (three dairies and cheese dairies, four apiaries and two meaderies, four pig farms and two tanneries), a warehouse and a second Trading Post upgrade; three Merchant houses, then salt pans and a butcher (sausages), hops from island 2 on route 1 with a wheat farm and a brewery (beer), leather works and a tailor (coats), a lumberjack, a paper mill and a printing press (books). Merchants unlock at minute 225, the first Merchant house stands at 235 and every Merchant category reaches 0.6 by 283 (targets 240 / 270 / 420).
